gate: GATE 4 — cascade certification (Wave H, workstream h14-cascade-cert)

method.harness: Linux proxy replay (Wave F f16 harness recreated as datasets/experiments/wave-h/h14-replay-all.sh) on committed runs-wave-a pose + oracle ball sidecars; NOT the canonical Mac/Apple Vision strict cascade
method.scope: every replayable non-holdout labeled case; held-out wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched and excluded from all denominators
method.grouping: metrics grouped by bundle/session/source, never frames-as-trials; machine labels treated as Tier-C only (all scoring against Gold)
method.environment: Linux, Node v20.18.1, pnpm; no Apple Vision pose extraction, no Mac, no iPhone available
method.rootGates: pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm format:check all pass at the release-candidate head on this branch (no production code changed)

target.detail: Lock correctness/persistence/no-takeover/occlusion-reacquisition need full-video Apple Vision pose runs; datasets/corpus/runs and datasets/paddle-bench/runs are absent at the RC head. Unit-level target persistence tests pass under pnpm test. Last canonical Mac measurement: 5/5 (STATUS_BOARD north star).

contact.wrongMarkerDetail: wavea-sasebo-volleys gold 52019ms: estimated 51875ms (err 144ms) at confidence 0.683 with ballConfirmed. Known f09 residual: estimate driven by ball-wrist-proximity + wrist-peak evidence while the sparse oracle ball annotation (500ms gap after the true turn sample) censors the dissenting turn. contact-evidence-4.3 restored censored mass to the confidence denominator so the row sits BELOW the 0.7 confident band (0.792 -> 0.683); the marker location is unchanged and still wrong.
contact.fabricatedMarkers: 0 markers claimed without ball/paddle evidentiary support
contact.vsWaveF: identical to f16 — no regression, no improvement

phase.vsWaveF: identical to f16 / f07 — no regression

stroke.status: MEASURED (Linux proxy, stroke heuristic bench on committed gold, 18 non-holdout rows)
stroke.declaredVsPredicted: DeclaredStroke and PredictedStroke remain separate surfaces; bench scores PredictedStroke only; UNKNOWN abstentions counted as abstentions, never correct
stroke.vsWaveF: f16: l1Correct 9, l2Correct 4, l2Wrong 3, confidentlyWrong 3. h14 (RC head): l1Correct 5, l2Correct 2, l2Wrong 2, confidentlyWrong 2. Wave-F stroke-hardening gates (f02 handedness crosscheck, f03 facing consensus, f04 bimanual, f05 shoulder degeneracy) converted several previously-confident rows into honest abstentions: confidently-wrong down 3 -> 2, at the cost of coverage (L1 abstention 8 -> 12 of 18).

strictCascadeNorthStar.detail: The end-to-end strict cascade (target->event->paddle->ball->contact->phase->stroke on the 5-case cascade set) requires full-video Apple Vision pose extraction on a Mac; not runnable on Linux. Last canonical measurement remains strict 2/5 (STATUS_BOARD). Nothing in the Linux-replayable stages shows a regression versus the artifacts underlying that 2/5.

oracleFrontierAnalysis.strokeConfidentWrong: Both wrong rows already sit at the oracle frontier for their stage: wavea-wgm-wheelchair @182400 uses referenceUsed=gold_contact (perfect contact oracle) with committed pose, and still commits FOREHAND at 0.8 against gold dink/backhand — binding cause is the wrist-midline side proxy defeated by a cross-body backhand (e03 root cause, re-verified). wavea-faead-rally @13417 has no gold contact (referenceUsed=wrist_speed_peak) and commits FOREHAND at 0.6 against gold groundstroke/backhand with confidence already capped by no_contact_evidence. Perfecting upstream stages does not flip either row.
oracleFrontierAnalysis.contactWrongMarker: With a perfect target/event oracle the sasebo row still errs 144ms: the binding cause is the sparse oracle ball annotation gap at the true turn (f09 root cause, re-verified) — better ball evidence density, not upstream cascade stages, is what is missing.

P0.title: Confident wrong stroke side on committed gold: wavea-wgm-wheelchair @182400 predicts FOREHAND at confidence 0.8; gold is dink/backhand (L2 wrong)
P0.rationale: Root-caused in e03 and re-verified here at the oracle frontier (gold-contact reference, committed pose): the wrist-midline side proxy is defeated by a cross-body backhand. Wave-F added four independent generalizable gates (f02–f05) which this row survives. Any further gate that flips this specific row would be tuned against 1–2 bench rows (bench-fitting, prohibited). The generalizable fix requires new measured evidence (paddle-face/handedness labels) — external label acquisition per the f15 plan. A second confidently-wrong row (wavea-faead-rally @13417, FOREHAND 0.6 vs gold backhand) shares the same binding cause with confidence already capped by no-contact-evidence limiting factors.

P1.title: Persistent wrong contact marker at moderate confidence: sasebo gold 52019 estimated 144ms early at 0.683 with ballConfirmed
P1.status: UNRESOLVED — not internally solvable without denser ball evidence
P1.rationale: Known f09 residual. contact-evidence-4.3 already removed the silent-failure character (confidence forced below the 0.7 confident band by restoring censored mass — a structural inequality, not a tuned constant). The marker location itself cannot be corrected internally: the only dissenting true-turn ball sample is followed by a 500ms annotation gap, so moving the estimate would mean re-tuning gap censoring against one gold row. Not a silent high-confidence failure under the repo silent-failure-v1 contract (confidence < 0.7, limiting factors carried), but it is a wrong marker a user could see with visible uncertainty — must-fix before broad release via denser ball labels/detection (external).

P1.title: Stroke coverage on supported capture is low: L1 abstention 12/18 on committed gold at the RC head (was 8/18 pre-hardening)
P1.status: UNRESOLVED — accepted trade-off, external to improve
P1.rationale: The Wave-F hardening gates that cut confidently-wrong 3 -> 2 also raised abstention. The remaining abstentions carry honest limiting factors (paddle_not_tracked_at_contact, no_contact_evidence, degenerate shoulder geometry). Recovering coverage without re-admitting confident wrong predictions requires better paddle tracking/contact evidence, which is label/detector-bound (f15 LABEL_STARVED finding).

P1.title: Ball hard-slice observed accuracy 9/35
P1.rationale: Identical to f16/f08; occlusion honesty invariants hold (0 occluded-prediction violations, 2/2 occluded abstentions). Known ORANGE.

P2.title: Event mis-bounding on 1/16 gold events and 2 missed low-amplitude events
P2.rationale: Recall 13/16 with 0 false proposals in non-event spans; misses are low-amplitude strokes at the proposal floor.

silentFailures.detail: No silent high-confidence failure (confident band >=0.7) exists in any replayable stage at the RC head: contact confidentWrongMarkers=0 (the one wrong marker sits at 0.683 with limiting factors), stroke L1 wrong=0, occluded ball predictions=0. The two confidently-wrong stroke L2 rows are visible bench findings (P0 above), already root-caused via oracle frontier analysis; neither is fixable internally without bench-fitting.

verdictRationale: The cascade-certification gate FAILS for unrestricted release: one P0 remains unresolved (confident wrong stroke SIDE at 0.8 on committed gold, not internally solvable — requires external label acquisition), plus three P1s (moderate-confidence wrong contact marker, low stroke coverage, weak hard-slice ball accuracy), all external-evidence-bound. No regression versus the Wave-F baseline was found in any replayable stage; stroke honesty improved (confidently-wrong 3 -> 2, L1 wrong 0). The canonical Mac strict-cascade rerun (historical 2/5) is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL on this Linux environment and must be rerun on a Mac before a final GO. Evidence here is Linux-proxy only and is explicitly NOT a claim of iPhone/Mac results.
recommendation: NO-GO for broad release on this gate until (a) the canonical Mac strict cascade is rerun on the RC head and (b) the stroke-side P0 is either fixed with new labeled evidence or the product surfaces PredictedStroke side with explicit uncertainty (DeclaredStroke remains the authoritative user-declared surface). All Linux-replayable invariants (no fabricated contact, no occluded-ball claims, no L1 stroke lies, event false-proposal zero) hold at the RC head.
